mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.5% signals monetary tightening, increasing borrowing costs and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are rising, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) indicates a tight labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5%, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) reflects strong manufacturing output, supporting economic growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is rising, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1600 thousand units signals weakening residential demand, which typically precedes economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST < 1600, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceed their 3-month moving averages, it indicates sustained consumer demand momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index level above 275 signals elevated inflation, which typically triggers monetary policy tightening and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 275, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
